changelog: Intent-named entry point for Amazon product data
display_name: Amazon Product Data API - Search, ASIN Lookup, Offers
summary: Search Amazon, read full product detail by ASIN, and list every seller offer on an ASIN with the buy-box winner. Clean normalized JSON with price, rating, review count, availability, shipping and sellers. 3 endpoints, all 1 credit, 22 marketplaces.
